NOTIFICATION
Applications in the prescribed format are invited from qualified hands for appointment to
various Technical staff posts on contract basis in the Division of Mechanical Engineering,
School of Engineering as detailed below.

Age limit:
18-40 years as on 01.01.2026 with usual relaxation as per Government Rules
and Regulations.
Other conditions:
The appointment will be on contract basis for a period of 1 (one) year with break during
May-June vacation months, extendable up to 2 years. Reservation Rules are applicable
for appointment to the above posts. All proceedings pursuant to the said notification will
be subjected to the result of the writ Petitions or Writ Appeals, if any, connected with the
matter pending before the Hon'ble High Court of Kerala.
How to apply:
1. Interested candidates may apply online through the website of Cochin University of
Science and Technology, i.e, recruit.cusat.ac.in on or before 30.10.2026
2. Separate application with prescribed fee should be submitted online for each post
having separate serial number.
3. The signed hard copy of the uploaded form with prove of age, educational
qualification, experience, community should reach the "Registrar, Administrative
Office, Cochin University of Science and Technology, Kochi - 22" on or
before 06.11.2026 with the superscription on the envelope "Application for the
post of Technician Grade II in the division of M echanical Engineering in the
School of Engineering on contract basis"
4. Late and defective applications will be summarily rejected.
Fee Details
₹950/- for General and OBC candidates and ₹195/- for SC/ST candidates.
M ode of Remittance
Online payment (through Net banking or Credit / Debit cards of almost all banks )
(Payment by cash / Cheque / DD will not be accepted)
